drafts.summary: The Sun and Mercury together in the 10th house form both Budhaditya yoga and a kendra-trikona Raja yoga [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. claims.text: The Sun, lord of the 4th, joins Mercury, lord of the 5th, in the 10th house: a kendra lord with a trikona lord, neither owning the 6th, 8th or 12th [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/34/11-12] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/34/15].

Mars in its own sign Scorpio, a kendra from the lagna, forms Ruchaka yoga, scaled down by Saturn's aspect, the Pratyak tara and Marana Karaka Sthana [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/75/1-2].
Counted from the Sun, Mars sits in the 10th house, so Ruchaka yoga also forms from the Sun [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:Phaladeepika/Sastri-1937/6/1].
